name: NIRWALS
notes: detector: xbin and ybin are set from the FITS header entry PIXSUM
gratings: gr_ang and ar_ang are set from the FITS header entries GR-ANGLE and AR-ANGLE
slit: phi (width in arcseconds) is set as the width of the fibres making up the pseudo-slit
slit: width (in mm) is calculated after the slit is initialised
